name: lg_epoch_1f0
doc: Stands in for the owner's Epoch capture (saves/epoch_re/epoch_user.state: world 1F0, riding, wings), from which the cockpit's states were played: the End of Time's party aboard the Epoch over 1000 A.D. -- the vehicle bytes set as the capture's ($027E = 2 riding, $028F = 2 vehicle A, $0283-$0286 and $0290-$0294 its place (138,128) and state E3: wings, aboard; $029F-$02A0 its world 1F0: the boarding at the End of Time is not walked here) and world 1F0 entered through the ROM's overworld loader (`ct.exe --teleport 496 78 75 3 --method ow`, the capture's arrival cell, 300 frames). The owner's drive from it (Y, Up, A, then A every 32) runs on the capture's frames: 1B0 f473, CHANGELOC 1DA staged f2752, `FF 26` f2771 (the capture's f2770), END f4412.
